description: Angular component for managing dashboard layout configurations, including breakpoint management, layout settings, and user interactions within a dialog interface.

classes.name: ManageDashboardLayoutsDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing dashboard layout configurations, including breakpoint management, layout settings, and user interactions within a dialog interface.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Unsubscribes from all active subscriptions to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if a form control is in an error state, considering custom validation.

methods.name: openLayoutSettings
methods.description: Opens a dialog to modify layout settings for a specific layout and breakpoint.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Closes the dialog without saving changes.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the current layout configuration, updating layout types and dimensions.

methods.name: buttonFlexValue
methods.description: Calculates the flex value for layout buttons based on current form state.

methods.name: formatSliderTooltipLabel
methods.description: Formats the tooltip label for sliders based on layout type.

methods.name: layoutControlChange
methods.description: Adjusts related layout control values when one is changed.

methods.name: setFixedLayout
methods.description: Sets the fixed layout side ('main' or 'right') when in fixed layout mode.

methods.name: showTooltip
methods.description: Displays validation error messages as tooltips for layout controls.

methods.name: layoutButtonClass
methods.description: Returns CSS classes for layout toggle buttons based on current state.

methods.name: layoutButtonText
methods.description: Provides localized text for layout toggle buttons.

methods.name: showPreviewInputs
methods.description: Determines whether preview input fields should be shown for a layout side.

methods.name: isDividerLayout
methods.description: Checks if the current layout type is a divider layout.

methods.name: addBreakpoint
methods.description: Opens a dialog to add a new breakpoint and handles its creation.

methods.name: deleteBreakpoint
methods.description: Removes a specified breakpoint after user confirmation.

methods.name: createdNewBreakpoint
methods.description: Creates a new breakpoint configuration, optionally copying from an existing one.

methods.name: addLayoutConfiguration
methods.description: Adds a layout configuration entry for a specific breakpoint.

methods.name: sortLayoutBreakpoints
methods.description: Sorts breakpoints and related lists by maximum width in descending order.
